description:
Dive into an amazing cubic world, where you can become anyone from a BANDIT to a ZOMBIE attacking everyone around! Imagine having 20 super cool cars at your disposal to ride, drift, and have fun on maps like "Russian Village," and "Courtyard," spaces filled with adventures.

You'll enjoy creating characters, each unique in their own way. You can assemble a team of bandits, zombies, or even police officers and engage in thrilling battles or cool races.

title: Love Calculator
description: Love Calculator is a free love calculator that analyzes your compatibility with a crush. Fill out your name and another person’s name to get the result you’ve been waiting for.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: My horse is amazing
description:
Ride a horse and overcome obstacles: fences, pits and water obstacles. Control the jumps — tap and release to jump accurately.

Collect powerups with powerups — increase attack and health. The further you run, the stronger your horse becomes!

Your steed is growing: it's getting faster and more powerful. Upgrade it and keep running. At the end of each level is a boss battle! Show what you are capable of!

title: X to Y: Almost Impossible!
description: X to Y is a fast-paced precision platform skill game focused on timing, reflexes, and speed control. Guide X through dangerous obstacles, traps, and tight spaces to reach Y. Every move requires perfect acceleration and sharp reactions — one mistake and you fail. Earn up to 3 stars per level to unlock new worlds, including dark mode challenges, auto-movement stages, and physics-based puzzles.

title: Spin Thru
description:
Fit the piece perfectly before the hole arrives!
Tap to rotate! Swipe left or right to flip!
When it’s ready, swipe up to send it through the hole.
Keep succeeding in a row to trigger Fever!
During Fever, easier puzzles will appear for a limited time!

title: Quiz Master
description:
Quiz Master is a fast-paced casual quiz game where you race against the clock—and other players—to prove you’ve got the wittiest brain in town.
Each match drops you into a question showdown spanning everything from pop culture and geography to brain-rot challenges.
When you answer a question correct you get 1 Block that will save you. If you pick the wrong answer you will stay where you are.
The water rises so make sure to answer correctly or you get eaten by the sharks.

title: Athena Match
description: Embark on a mythical journey in Athena Match, a Match 3 game set in Ancient Greece. Guided by the goddess Athena, match three or more identical artifacts to clear levels and uncover Greek secrets. Stunning visuals and rich soundscapes bring this world to life as you solve puzzles and overcome mythical obstacles inspired by Greek lore. Ready to prove your skills? Join Athena and dive into the adventure!

title: Drawing Squares
description:
Drawing Squares is the logic game that will blow your mind!
It is a logic game inspired by the classic pen and paper game Dots and Boxes. Do you remember the game you used to play at school? (also known as Boxes, Squares, Paddocks, Pigs in a Pen, Square-it, Dots and Dashes, Dots, Smart Dots, Dot Boxing, or, simply, the Dot Game).

title: Gal Sliding Puzzle
description:
It's a classic sliding puzzle.
You can challenge yourself by increasing the difficulty level from 3*3, 4*4, 5*5.
Train and activate your brain~
Complete it and meet various pretty girls.

title: TimeWarriors
description:
Lead your army to glory through the ages! Embark on an epic journey through history. From primitive battles of the Stone Age to the futuristic wars of the future — become the greatest commander the world has ever known.

Become a great commander and lead your army to victory! Play “Time Warriors” now!

title: Brainrot World Hole.io
description: Brainrot World Hole.io is a hilarious casual hole game packed with chaotic brainrot energy and funny Italian meme vibes. Control a growing hole and dive into a crazy world where swallowing everything in sight is the key to victory. Move around the map and collect objects smaller than your hole.

title: Holiday Hex Sort
description: In Holiday Hex Sort, drag and drop hex tile stacks onto the board. Merge tiles to form stacks of 10 and collect them. As levels progress, more tile types appear. If there are 10 similar tiles on a stack, they will be collected. Clear all tiles by making stacks of 10 before time runs out !

title: Avatar World Secrets
description: Dive into various cute items, design the room setting, dress up your avatar family, and make up a life story as you like. Enjoy the fun interaction with items and characters online.

title: Cars Derby Arena
description: Welcome to the world of Car Derby Arena! In this exciting game you can enjoy the unique experience of changing the color of cars, improving their performance, and manipulating gravity and weather conditions. Your goal is to become an invincible master of destruction, pump up your car and crush everything in your path. Embark on exciting missions, compete with other players and prove your skills in this epic Car Derby Arena game!

title: Smartle
description: Smartle is a free online word puzzle game where you rearrange letters by swapping them on a 5x5 grid to form words. Win the game by creating 5 horizontal 5-letter words on the field. There are multiple valid combinations of words which can win the game.

title: Tap It Away 3D
description: Tap It Away 3D is a fun and relaxing 3D block puzzle game. Tap the arrows to move and clear blocks, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and plan your moves carefully as blocks can block each other. Enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay with no time limits. Play this free online puzzle game to relax, sharpen your logic, and train your brain anytime.

title: Block Digger
description: Dig, Click, and Get Rich! In Block Digger, every tap brings you closer to fortune! Smash stones, collect coins and crystals, and upgrade your mine to skyrocket your earnings. Unlock new mines, chase achievements, and build your mining empire. It's easy, fun, and totally addictive—start digging today! ⛏️

title: My Perfect Year Planner
description: My Perfect Year Planner is a year-round dress-up game to match the month's event! Release DateJanuary 2021DeveloperMy Perfect Year Planner is made by Gamerina.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Human Leap Evolution
description: Want a wild evolution adventure from caveman to futuristic super warrior? Human Leap: Evolution is a high-energy action evolution puzzle game where every jump you make shapes your destiny. Choose wisely, evolve rapidly, and battle your enemies with unstoppable power!

title: World Flags Trivia
description: Challenge your geography skills in World Flags Trivia! Identify the nation for each flag from three choices across 194 questions. Perfect your skills as you progress through increasingly tricky questions. Can you score a perfect game and become a true flag expert? Play now and find out!

title: Nugget Man Survival Puzzle
description: Are you ready for adventure with the Nugget man character? To save the Nugget Man character who is stranded in the desert, you must fly into the sky without bursting the balloons. You must be careful to take the character to the finish by solving the puzzles before time runs out, accompanied by Gedagedago music. Rescue Nugget Man through desert bandits, cacti and many other challenging obstacles! Enjoy.

title: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle
description: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle is an irresistibly fun puzzle casual game that bursts with juicy visuals and addictive gameplay! A brilliant combination of puzzle and match mechanics. From the moment you start, you’ll be hooked on its satisfying matching mechanics and clever level design.

title: Obby Draw to Escape
description:
Have a blast in Obby illustrating your way to victory! Play the fun and relaxing casual game Draw to Escape and see if you can overcome the levels' issues using just your creativity.

You may earn money as you go through the levels, and you can earn even more coins when you reach the end of each level for every star you find. Things may vanish or explode and kill you, so be sure to check every level thoroughly.

title: Serious Bro
description: Defend your base against adorable alien invaders using an M16 Carbine Rifle and frag grenades. Experience a beautiful low poly 3D environment with cute enemies and simple controls for both desktop and mobile.

title: Mojicon Fruit Connect
description:
Match. Collect. Get Inspired! Dive into Mojicon Fruit Connect, the vibrant puzzle game where every match brings you closer to a new discovery. Connect colorful emoji tiles to clear the board, but watch out for shifting gravity and frozen that tiles will keep you on your toes!

Complete levels to fill your Album with cute characters. Reveal meaningful quotes and daily inspiration with every unlock. Return to your Fruit Farm later to claim a basket full of free rewards. 

Play anywhere you like!

title: Frost Defense
description:
❄️ Embark on a thrilling journey through a frozen wilderness in Frost Defense, a strategic tower defense game that puts your tactical skills to the test! ??

In this action-packed adventure, you'll take on the role of a lone survivor ?‍♂️ battling against the relentless onslaught of arctic creatures ??‍❄️?.
The enemy is merciless — only your ingenuity and strategic prowess can keep you alive in this harsh frozen world. ⚔️?️

title: Uno Online
description:
UNO Online is a strategy card game. In the game, the first player to clear his hand will become the winner. In order to win, you need to guess the deck of cards in your opponent's hands and  arrange your card order reasonably. There are also function cards in the game. When you draw a function card, think about how to turn the situation to your advantage. You can use color cards to
change the color of the game, or use +2 cards to make your opponent's cards never run out.

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Heat Incremental
description: Heat Incremental is a challenging strategy-puzzle game where your goal is surprisingly simple: heat up the planet. Start with basic clean energy sources, then research increasingly extreme methods to generate more heat.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: DTA 2: Maniac
description: DTA 2: Maniac. Create chaos like GTA. Use a vast arsenal of weapons, steal bulldozers, buses, police cars, tanks and much more - destruction is all around!

title: Memoji
description: Match pairs of emojis and word cards to uncover and learn about a significant historical event from around the world each day.

title: Slithoria
description:
Slithoria is a fast-paced arcade game where you compete to become the biggest snake in the arena. Collect glowing orbs, grow larger, outsmart your rivals, and survive as long as possible.

Defeat other snakes by cutting them off, collect the orbs they leave behind, and grow even faster. Unlock 40 unique skins by completing challenges and customize your snake.

With smooth controls and colorful visuals, every match is a new challenge.

Enter the arena and become the biggest snake in Slithoria!

title: Turbo Race
description:
Get ready to burn rubber in Turbo race, the ultimate racing experience of the fastest and most powerful cars in the world. Whether youre a casual gamer or a hardcore racing enthusiast.
Race through a variety of stunning locations, each with its own unique challenges.

title: The Road Home: Granny Escape
description: Step into the chilling world of The Road Home: Granny Escape, a horror escape room experience where every shadow hides danger. Solve puzzles, collect items, and find a way out while being relentlessly hunted by Granny and Grandpa. Use stealth, strategy, and courage to survive this terrifying challenge and make your way to freedom.

title: Boyfriend For Hire
description: Pushed by her mom to start dating, studious Amy hires charming transfer student Javier to pose as her boyfriend. Rival Christie, jealous rumors, and a flirty study partner turn the act into real complications. Choose outfits, make tough choices, and decide if this love is real—or just for show.

title: BBQ Sort Puzzle
description:
This is an interesting elimination puzzle game!

You need to put three identical items into the same grill to complete the grilling.

The difficulty of the game increases step by step.

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: Crush the Eggs
description: In this game, eggs have appeared that you will have to fight with and break. In front of you on the screen you will see a platform on which the egg will be located. Above it you will see a special field. Using the mouse you can draw any object on it. When you finish your actions, this item will fall directly onto the egg. If your calculations are correct, then you will break it and thus destroy it. After this you will move to the next level of the game.

title: Hide And Seek Blue Monster
description: Enter a world full of mystery and fun. In Hide And Seek: Blue Monster, you will experience a unique hide-and-seek adventure. The game combines casual games with puzzle challenges. You should keep running away to prevent being caught by the blue monster, and when the blue monster is staring at you, hold stop in front of the fruit, in front of the coke, or front of the water glass, etc.

title: Gym Simulator - Tycoon
description: Welcome to Gym Simulator - Tycoon, where your business dreams take shape in the world of fitness. In this engaging online game, you'll manage and grow a network of gyms—upgrade your facilities, invest in top-notch equipment, and fine-tune every detail to run smoothly. Whether you're playing on your phone or computer, dive into a game where strategy meets a passion for health. With dynamic gameplay, you'll turn a small operation into a booming fitness brand.

title: Snake 2048.io
description: Cubes are all around the arena and it is time to collect these cubes and merge them to have a longer 2048 cube snake! A great 2048 game begins with cube snakes and cubes in a huge arena. You will start with a low number of snakes, collect lower numbered cubes around the map, and try to make your snake bigger by combining numbers. Collect power-ups and give your snake more advantages.

title: Shadow Stickman Fight
description: Shadow Stickman Fight is an awesome and intense 2D ninja survival arcade game. You have to survive the endless waves of enemies with stickman ninjas. Every time you pass a belt exam, you get the examiner’s hat and weapon. You can use souls to trade items or earn gifts. You have to follow the white dots and hit the enemies. You have to time your attack when enemies are in your attack distance. You can also enter the arsenal and choose different equipment, like helmets and weapons.

title: Obby Massive Attack
description:
Help the Obby blox friends to rescue the hapless citizens of a city. During the adventure, you'll get bonuses that give you superpowers that will allow you to sweep aside everything in your path.
Obby Masive Attack is the ideal game for anyone who loves the running game genre. This time, Obby and friends are the protagonist - the game offers fast gameplay, nice graphics, special effects and good playability.
Collect coin and buy new power ups, and run forever in this fantastic endless adventure.

title: Children Happy Farm DuDu
description: Hey there, little farmers in the making! Welcome to "Children Happy Farm DuDu"! This is an amazing casual simulator designed just for your kids. In this fun-filled farm world, you'll be the boss of your farm. The farm is full of cute animals like fluffy sheep, clucking chickens, and friendly cows. Your job is to take good care of them. Feed the animals, clean their shelters, and make sure they are happy.

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description:
In this physics-based innovative puzzle game, your objective is to strategically place screws and nuts to fall all the wooden blocks.
Unleash your cognitive ability as you tackle each brain-teasing level, each one designed to test your problem-solving skills. From simple puzzles to complex constructions, this 2D puzzle game offers an array of challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

title: Car Out Jam
description:
Car Parking. A puzzle game with cars and passengers.
Complete interesting levels with various mechanics!
The game will be interesting for both who want to relax leisurely and for those who like to unravel complex moves.
Easy levels are combined with more difficult ones. And some will be a real challenge for your brain!

title: Card Clash : Battle Arena
description:
Card Clash: Battle Arena is an exciting card-merge battle game where strategy and timing decide victory!

Merge cards of the same color to create powerful characters.
After merging 5 identical cards, a unique hero is summoned to the battlefield. These heroes automatically fight enemies, pushing forward step by step.

Defeat all enemies to advance, then lead your characters to destroy the enemy base and complete the level!

title: Idle Barber Shop
description: Play Idle Barber Shop free online and run your own salon in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Hire barbers, upgrade stations, style fresh cuts, and grow profits in a smart tycoon experience that feels like a light brain game of strategy and timing. This unblocked game works smoothly at school or home, is fully mobile-friendly, and runs perfectly on desktop and mobile. A free online game made for quick breaks and relaxing play.

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: OMG Word Sushi
description: Swipe to connect letters and form words in this sushi-themed word puzzle game. Challenge your vocabulary with over 81 levels and a minimalist cartoon style. Perfect for trivia and quiz enthusiasts. Think it's easy? Try the advanced levels!

title: Sticker Puzzle Book
description: Step into the captivating world of Sticker Puzzle, where creativity and strategy come together in a beautifully immersive experience. Explore a vibrant sticker book filled with artistic challenges, visual storytelling, and mind-bending puzzles. Designed as a peaceful chromatic retreat, Sticker Puzzle blends the calming satisfaction of sticker art with the engaging thrill of strategic problem-solving — the perfect harmony of relaxation and mental stimulation.

title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
description: Exotic cars, mega ramps, colorful giant bosses and face to face races all come together in this game. GT Cars Mega Ramps invites you to a fantastic driving experience with its completely unique game-play. Fly over mega ramps with your customized exotic car, destroy giant bosses or try to finish the stages first in face to face races!

title: Lights Out
description: Lights Out is a minimalist puzzle platformer with a twist: the level is pitch black. Reveal your surroundings by emitting light, but there's a catch: you can't move while the lights are on. Memorize in the dark to move in the light. Master timing, memory, and reflexes to conquer each world’s unique mechanics.

title: Animal Transform Race
description: Animal Transform Race is a fun game based on reaction where different types of animals compete. Each animal is fast in some areas and very slow in some tracks according to their abilities. Try to lead the race by making the right choices. The faster you make animal choices, the more advantages you gain. You can unlock new animals from the market section with the coins you earn from the races.

title: Boost Your Brain!
description: "Boost Your Brain!" is an exciting incremental game where you develop your mind by collecting Aiku! Click the magic book, upgrade skills, collect pets with bonuses, and customize with skins. Enjoy deep progression, endless leveling, and cute companions. Reach new heights and become a genius!

title: Cannon Shooter
description: Cannon Shooter is an exciting arcade shooter where you can have endless shooting fun in fast-paced combat! You will control a cannonball firing hordes of heroic characters, facing many enemies. A quick click to launch more heroes and help you generate more heroes through the digital gate.

title: Bubble Plopper
description: In Bubble Plopper you can either try to prevent the bubbles from filling the playfield in Classic mode or try to clear the playfield within the given time in Time attack mode. Shooting bubbles has never been so fun. Plop plop!

title: Trial Xtreme
description: Trial Xtreme is an exciting game in which you have to get a new experience from driving a motorcycle. Experience a sea of adrenaline while riding a motorcycle and passing 30 levels with dizzying and spectacular obstacles.

title: Infinite Craft
description: This is a crafting game in which you start with four elements - Fire, Earth, Water, and Wind. Combine elements to create new elements. Find bizarre and fun combos. Enjoy an open and stress-free exploration experience.

title: Idle Landmark Builder
description: Enjoy a casual idle simulation management game in the Idle Landmark - Builder. Here, you'll play the role of a construction tycoon and build world-famous landmarks from scratch. Manage workers to increase speed or your income, hire more workers and build your own construction empire. Build world-famous landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the Pyramids, and witness the entire process of their construction.

title: Bubble Shooter Pirate Treasures
description: Set sail in Bubble Shooter Pirate Treasures, an endless pirate-themed bubble shooter! Aim, match, and pop bubbles to build combos, chase your best score, and fill the Treasure Progress bar. Unlock pirate backgrounds, matching bubble skins, and useful boosters as every run brings you closer to the next reward. Easy to play and fun to master—keep the bubbles away from the fail line and hunt for treasure!

title: Car Park Simulator
description: Welcome to Car Park Simulator, Are you ready to test your driving skills and master the art of parking? Navigate through 72 challenging levels filled with obstacles and narrow spaces...

title: Sprunki Mini Games
description: We present you a compilation of several games with the famous characters Sprunki. The first game is the classic Sprunki game but with an expanded orchestra, that is, with 9 singers. In the second game, you are presented with 10 pictures to color. While the third is a game of finding differences where you have 20 levels with 10 differences on each level.

title: Candy Chain Master
description: Welcome to Candy Chain Master! The board has blue tiles with candies on them. Start by selecting a candy and move across nearby tiles with the same candy to make a chain of three or more. Each tile must turn golden by matching at least one candy on it. Think carefully and move fast to turn all tiles golden before time runs out.

title: Slap Man
description:
Slap Man is a hyper-casual parkour game that involves sliding left and right. You sprint through the streets, dodging roadblocks and traps, while sending passing NPCs staggering with well-timed slaps. Its easy to play, brainless and refreshing. If you want to get high scores, you have to be accurate, fast and bad enough.
Suitable for playing in fragmented time, supports mouse/touch operation, and is an easy-to-learn little spoof of parkour!

title: Pop Star
description: Ready to relax, think, and have fun all at once? In Star Pop Mania, the rules are simple, but the satisfaction is endless. Tap two or more matching blocks to pop them and clear the board. The bigger the combo, the higher the score—and the more rewarding it feels!

title: Mini Scrapbook Paper
description: Mini Scrapbook Paper is a super cute art game made for girls. Do you have a journal? Have you ever designed your journal with your own style? In this game, you can design a journal freely. With colorful pages, fancy stickers and other cute accessories we prepared for you, you can use your imagination as much as you like. Have a good time!

title: Candy Smash
description: Candy Smash is a lively and addictive puzzle game where players tap on clusters of sweet candies to clear them and rack up points. Plan your moves wisely to clear the board and set new high scores before your lives run out! Featuring bright, colorful graphics and a delightful candy-themed world, this match-and-clear adventure is perfect for players of all ages.

title: 2048 Block Fusion
description:
"2048 Block Fusion" is not just 2048. This is a new generation of numerical puzzles where blocks fall, merge, increase their values and unlock unexpected possibilities!

Choose one of the three modes:
Adventures — complete levels, unlock special blocks and solve problems with a limited number of moves.
Advanced — endless mode with bonuses and special blocks for those who love freedom and strategy.
Classic — familiar mechanics without unnecessary elements, for the pure pleasure of merging.

title: Mahjong Tile Club
description: Step into the relaxing world of Mahjong Tile Club, where timeless tile-matching meets innovative gameplay! This solitaire-style mahjong game is perfect for anyone looking for a calm yet engaging puzzle experience. With simple rules and soothing gameplay, it’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Match identical tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

title: Triple Tile Twister Match Game
description: Triple Tile Twister: Match Game is a relaxing puzzle with a twist on mahjong. Clear the board by matching groups of three identical tiles. ?✨ Strategically select tiles to move to the holding area, which holds up to 7 tiles. Create sets of three to clear them, but watch out! ? If the area fills with unmatched tiles, the game ends. Enjoy soothing graphics and relaxing gameplay—perfect for unwinding! ? Great for both mahjong fans and newcomers! ?

title: Mahjong Cute Tiles
description: Enjoy a classic Mahjong game, now in another dimension! Rotate the board, explore fresh tile layouts and challenge your mind. Show off your skills and use powerful boosters like undo moves, tile shuffles, bombs and hints to help you advance faster.

title: Italian Brainrot Clicker
description: Italian Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious one-button idle clicker that throws you into the chaotic charm of the Italian Brainrot universe. Fueled by Gen-Z meme culture and AI-generated madness, this game unleashes a world of mutant creatures and meme-fueled mayhem. From dancing cappuccinos to cactus-bodied elephants, every tap pulls you deeper into a spiral of satire and brainrot. It is weird, it is wild, and it is wonderfully addictive. You will not believe what you are unlocking next!

title: Age of Apes Run
description: Welcome to the wildest adventure of the ape era! Age of Apes Run is a fun platform running game. It is full of puzzles and nervous battles. Perfect for every arcade-loving boy out there! You'll be a brave ape warrior and run through a platform full of obstacles! Collect many bananas to boost your skills.

title: Spooky Link
description: Spooky Link is a relaxing Halloween-themed game where you connect matching spooky tiles. Tap a tile, then tap its match. If the path between them has two or fewer turns, the tiles are cleared. Each cleared tile creates more space to connect others. Enjoy many levels of fun with Halloween surprises!

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Cut In Half
description:
Cut obstacles in the way with knives or characters.
If you touch a red block or fall into a valley, it's a game over.
Collect the goods as much as you cut the obstacles to unlock new characters!

title: Fishing Bear
description:
Tap to reel in your fishing line and catch as many fish as you can!
But stay alert—mischievous creatures in the sea will try to get in your way.
And when you pick up a mysterious Treasure Shell… something exciting might happen!
Enjoy a simple and addictive fishing experience!

title: Eastern Star vs City Style Icon
description: Welcome to the world of style, where the ancient palaces of the East meet the splendor of a modern metropolis! Two beautiful heroines are waiting for you in the game: an oriental beauty with exquisite outfits in the style of an Ottoman fairy tale and a stylish urban fashionista conquering the catwalks of the metropolis. During the game, you will become a fashion stylist and create unique looks for each of the girls. Choose your side in the cultural dispute and make this choice a reality!

title: Color Ring Sorting Match
description: Color Ring - Sorting Match is a vibrant and addictive sorting challenge that turns simple ring stacking into a clever strategic experience! Every move matters as you plan how to clear the board efficiently. This game delivers a perfect balance of fun and challenge. It’s a satisfying puzzle experience with a casual vibe, all centered around clever ring mechanics. Ideal for quick play sessions or longer brain-teasing moments!

title: Save Stranding Fish
description: Help all the little fish that unfortunately wash up on the beach to escape their predicament.You must pay attention to the order in which you rescue the fish.

title: Caterfall 2048
description: Caterfall 2048 is a vibrant reimagining of the classic 2048 puzzle set in a cozy feline atmosphere. It combines familiar merging mechanics with a hexagonal grid and fun "jelly" physics. This game is perfect for all puzzle lovers — whether you want to relax or you're a competitive player striving for a new high score.

title: Land Cruiser Offroad Driver
description: Take your cute dog along for a thrilling offroading adventure, and complete 4 awesome game modes across the city map with your awesome SUV. Customize and Upgrade it to your liking and ride in style across the giant offroading map. If you create nuisance in the city, the cops will be on your tail to chase you down. Drift the tires off the SUV and make as much money as you can. Are you ready for this thrilling adventure?

title: Seafaring Memory Challenge
description: Set sail into the captivating depths of the ocean with Seafaring Memory Challenge! Match pairs of sea-themed icons in an endless array of levels. Test your memory skills as you uncover treasures like colorful fish, delicate sea shells, and sunken treasures. With no level limit, the adventure never ends, providing hours of entertainment. Stay sharp and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the waves!

title: Word Search Universe Easter
description: Word Search Universe: Easter is a fun and relaxing puzzle game with a happy spring theme. Enjoy colorful eggs, soft colors, and a peaceful mood while finding hidden words. Easy to play and great for all ages, it’s a perfect way to relax and enjoy the Easter season.

title: Bolts
description:
Test your logic and strategy in this unique puzzle game. Solve intricate challenges by unscrewing bolts in the right order—every move counts.

Features:
Unique Levels – Each puzzle offers a fresh challenge.

Strategic Gameplay – The sequence of moves is key.

Engaging Puzzles – Designed to push your problem-solving skills.

Every detail matters. Can you master the mechanics?

title: Life Clicker
description:
Life Clicker: Move to Success - Live your dream life!
   In this unique indie life simulation game, you can explore various careers in cafes and factories, unwind in luxurious or budget-friendly apartments, and have fun in different exciting places. Hone your skills with new jobs, advance to the top of your chosen profession, and reach new heights of success.
   Join the thrilling adventure of Life Clicker and become a success story today!

title: Gear Wars
description: Do you have the strategic skill to build a flawless factory, producing Brutes, Archers, and Grunts? Manage your budget wisely, crush every enemy, and claim victory! Get those gears spinning... it's time to WIN!

title: Koko Loco Block Blast
description: Think fast, blast smart — can you beat your best score? Blast blocks, fit shapes, and outsmart the grid in this fast-paced puzzle challenge! Every move counts: clear space, chain combos, and keep the board from filling up. With smooth controls, colorful blocks, and quick rounds, it’s perfect for casual fun or deep strategy. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — how high can you climb the high score ladder?

title: Real Car Parking Simulator
description:
Get ready to test your driving skills in Real Car Parking Simulator. In the parking simulation game, you will face various parking challenges. With realistic controls and detailed environments,you’ll feel like you're actually behind the wheel. From parallel parking to tight garage spaces,
this game offers many parking challenges.

title: Zombie Siege.io
description: As a soldier at the last base with unlimited potential, you must arm yourself and battle against dangerous zombies! Use your wisdom to select the best weapons, skills, and talents to defend against waves of zombies. How many maps will you be able to save?

title: Escape From Tung Tung Sahur
description: Escape From Tung Tung Sahur is a fast-paced runner-platformer where quick reflexes are your only chance of survival! You play as a lone runner escaping the bizarre and relentless anomaly known as Tung Tung Sahur. Sprint across platforms, leap over deadly gaps, and avoid sudden obstacles. title: House Deep Clean Sim
description:
House Deep Clean Sim is a home-themed cleaning game with a strong sense of experience. It has 9 scenes for you to clean, which are fence, sculpture, trampoline, pool, robot, fountain, ground,
car, and dining table. Not only does it have a rich scene, but it also has everything you need for a clean game, such as full 3D effects, resizable nozzle size, and the ability to move around at will.  Try it if you are interested. Have fun.

title: Water Dig Rescue
description: Dive into the captivating world of "Water Dig Rescue," a physics-based puzzle game where strategy and water manipulation go hand-in-hand. Players carve their way through sand to guide streams of water, aiming to fill a waiting truck at each level's end. With a touch of ingenuity and the laws of physics, can you solve the puzzles and achieve a triumphant splash?

title: Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure
description: Hill Climb: Truck Transform Adventure is actually a 2D balance stunt adventure game. You have 3 kinds of vehicles to transform and overpass different terrains. While keeping the vehicle balanced, you can climb different ramps and terrains. If you crash obstacles or terrains, you can collect repair plates to recover. If you want to overpass the next harder levels, you can upgrade your vehicles with 4 acceleration abilities.

title: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!

title: CodeQuest
description:
CodeQuest is a cyberpunk adventure game where you learn 
real Python programming by writing actual code to defeat 
enemies and save the Digital World! Write Python code to 
power your hero across 10 missions. No prior coding 
experience needed.

title: Cat Evolution
description:
Embark on a paws-itively thrilling journey of discovery and creativity in Cat Evolution! Combine adorable cats to unlock hilarious and surprising new species. From cuddly kittens to fantastical hybrids, every merge brings you closer to unveiling the ultimate evolution.

Merge & Unlock Cats Evolutions. 
Build Your Cat Universe!

title: HeroBall Adventures 2
description: It’s time to embark on a brand new adventure in this great game, this time in a spherical theme! Heroball Adventures 2 is finally here! It’s a fun game where heroball has to save his friends who were abducted by a strange machine on an otherwise calm day. Control the character, jump over obstacles and try to save all of your friends. Be sure to try to get to the end of each level. Collect points and unlock new abilities!

title: Popcorn Fun Factory
description: Popcorn Fun Factory is a fun idle game where you get to run your very own popcorn factory! Start off small and work your way up by unlocking new production lines and creating different flavors of delicious popcorn. With simple and intuitive gameplay, you can sit back and relax while your factory does all the work for you.

title: Paw Clash
description: Paw Clash is an exciting party game where cute animals compete in fun challenges. Enjoy a variety of mini-games that test your skills and reflexes in colorful environments. With simple controls and increasing difficulty, Paw Clash offers endless fun for players of all ages.

title: Lovie Chics Spring Break Fashion
description: Lovie Chics Spring Break Fashion” is your ultimate destination for chic and trendy outfits perfect for the spring break season! Explore our curated collection of vibrant dresses, stylish swimwear, and must-have accessories designed to elevate your style and make a statement wherever you go. Whether you’re hitting the beach, lounging by the pool, or exploring new destinations, we have everything you need to look and feel fabulous all spring break long.

title: Dragon Joust (.io)
description: Dragon Joust is a .io game where you must hop aboard your dragon and joust! As you knock enemies off their dragons, you can collect the loot they drop.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Dungeons n' Ducks
description: Dungeons n' Ducks is a puzzle game where you guide the duckie through a dungeon by rotating rooms and adjusting water levels. Your goal is to help Duckie collect keys and navigate to freedom.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: College Girls Team Makeover
description: Try our new fashionista app "College Girls Team Makeover". Here you can dress up 5 high school best friends. They are the most popular school girls and always together. Everyone would like to be in their girl squad! They manage to be the most stylish girls in school, because they have their own fashion stylist and that’s you! You can control their whole look from the color of their skin and eyes to hairstyle and makeup. More than 1000 items of clothes and accessories are at your disposal!

title: WarCall.io
description: WarCall.io is an IO fantasy battle royale game where champions battle in a large multiplayer arena using various melee weapons.How to Play WarCall.ioFight in a fiercely competitive arenaFight against other players for gold and upgrades as the map decreases in size.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Foot Chinko: Russia 2018
description: Foot Chinko: Russia 2018 is the virtual version of the family favorite soccer game – Foot Chinko! This is the 2018 world cup version and you get to play with your favorite nations.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Foxy Eco Sort
description:
Join Foxy and Raccoon on their eco-mission! Sort waste, play match-3 and matching pairs to clean polluted locations. 

But it's not just cleaning! Uncover the conspiracy of cunning Ratty who wants to destroy the forest. Complete story chapters: track garbage trucks, expose arsonists and save your home!

title: War Robots Battles
description: Enter the future battlefield, and lead your powerful robots in exciting battles. War Robots Battles lets you feel the most exciting robot action. You can attack with powerful weapons and use strategy to win. Choose your robot, equip powerful weapons, and build the strongest combat team. Choose from wind sword, imperial bow, etc.

title: Planetarium 2
description: Planetarium is an awesome game of adventure and exploration in which you can watch our solar system in action and see how the different planets and stars interact with each other and around our galaxy - this is an epic planet simulation game! Use your mouse to move around the universe and check out how our solar system works.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Papas Burger Cook
description:
Cook and travel through amazing burger restaurants, discover delicious recipes, prepare tasty meals, and serve hungry customers in the best burger shop.
This is a crazy cooking game full of fast kitchen action, burger fever, and food madness. Papas Burger Cook - fun cooking simulation game.
Become the ultimate burger chef, master every recipe, and reach the highest rank in this exciting food cooking adventure.

title: Santa Vs Skritch
description:
Everyone is busy celebrating Christmas and enjoying the holidays. But a critical showdown is happening somewhere in the woods!

Play against a friend or family member or challenge the AI to a duel. Do your best to kick the present past your opponent and score!

Will you help Santa or the Skritch? Come play now and show off your skills!

title: Traffic Light Simulator 3D
description:
"Traffic-Light simulator" is an immersive simulation game where players take on the role of a traffic controller tasked with managing the flow of vehicles through a bustling city intersection. Set against the backdrop of a dynamic urban landscape, players must strategically operate a traffic light to prevent congestion, accidents, and ensure smooth traffic flow.
With each passing level, the intensity and complexity of traffic increase, testing the player's decision-making skills and reflexes.

title: Robby: Bomberman
description:
Dive into an exciting adventure with Robby, a brave hero who finds himself trapped in a labyrinth filled with ghosts and mysterious loot boxes. In this danger-filled world, to unlock the exit, Robby must defeat all the ghosts and destroy the crates, which may contain precious coins and useful bonuses.

But Robby is not alone in his fight! He has a loyal ally—a magical mushroom that can emerge from the loot boxes to assist him in battles against the ghosts.

title: Gladiators. Merge and Fight
description: Gladiators: Merge and Fight is an engaging arcade game that combines character attribute creation and enhancement with combat. In this game, you start with basic materials and improve your gladiator's attributes by upgrading weapon, shield, armor, and helmet materials. Every decision affects your hero's stats. After preparing your gladiator, press the "Start" button to begin the second part of the game: arena battles.

title: Cube in Cube
description: Play the new 2048 game with unique mechanics! Develop strategies to clear cubes in endless mode or rescue the monkey. Challenge yourself now!

title: Plants Warfare
description: Plants Warfare is a shooting game where you step into the shoes of the cute plants. Aim your projectiles, and take down the zombies with strategic aiming and precision shots. Use the environment to your advantage—ricochet bullets and eliminate multiple targets with the least shots possible! Collect stars, customize your look, and prove you’re the ultimate plant defense.

title: Marble Run - Ultimate Race!
description:
Race, roll, and clash in Marble Run, the ultimate marble racing game! Guide your marble through physics-based tracks, dodge obstacles, knock rivals off the edge, and aim for the finish line. 

With fast-paced races, competitive knockout rounds, and fun marble skins, it’s the most addictive 3D marble runner you’ll play!

title: Palm Island Solitaire
description:
Palm Island Solitaire – Your Tropical Card Challenge! ☀️

Catch the island breeze with Palm Island Solitaire, a fresh twist on Golf Solitaire that blends strategy with sunny vibes.

Score low, reshuffle when needed, and enjoy every move with playful golf lingo and island flair.

Ready to relax, play smart, and swing into fun?  Let the adventure begin!

title: Garden Guardians
description:
A fun and strategic tower defense game that’s easy to pick up!
Tap directional arrows to launch seeds into flowerpots—each seed blossoms into a powerful flower ready to blast incoming zombies. Plan your moves, hold the line, and protect your garden from the undead horde!

title: Cashier Game
description: You play as a cashier who needs to punch the goods and give change to the customers. As you earn money, you can improve your store and buy new furnishings.

title: Football Penalty 2026
description: The time has come for the players to face off in an intense duel to prove who has the strongest, most accurate and most technically skilled kick. Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. The road to victory is yours!

title: Dino Simulator City Attack
description:
In the year 2024, not only are dinosaurs no longer seen, but they live peacefully with humans in the urban center. Not quite at peace, however!

Play as one of several prehistoric dinosaur species in this free 3D game where you may run, crush, demolish, leap, disturb, and do just about everything else you can imagine. Each level has its own set of objectives that you must accomplish in order to access the next. Picking your favorite dinosaur from the list of possible species is also an option.

title: Happy Fruit Link
description: Enjoy a fun and relaxing puzzle adventure in Happy Fruit Link! Match two identical fruit tiles and connect them with a line that can turn up to two times. Clear all tiles, solve challenging puzzles, and test your brain through exciting levels. With colorful graphics and smooth gameplay.
